packages.summary: Six nights across Kuala Lumpur and Singapore, covering Genting Highlands by cable car, Batu Caves, Gardens by the Bay and guided city tours in both cities.
packages.overview: This six-night holiday pairs three nights in Kuala Lumpur with three in Singapore. In Malaysia you see the Petronas Twin Towers and Merdeka Square, ride the Skyway cable car up to Genting Highlands and visit Batu Caves. You then drive to Singapore for a guided city tour and Gardens by the Bay, with optional Sentosa, Universal Studios and Oceanarium days left for you to choose.

packages.summary: Ten nights across Pattaya, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Singapore, with Coral Island, Genting Highlands, Gardens by the Bay and Sentosa on one itinerary.
packages.overview: A ten-night, three-country holiday that moves from the beaches and temples of Thailand to the towers of Kuala Lumpur and the gardens of Singapore. You spend two nights in Pattaya, two in Bangkok, three in Kuala Lumpur and three in Singapore. Highlights include Coral Island by speedboat, a Chao Phraya dinner cruise, Genting Highlands, Gardens by the Bay and a day at Mandai Bird Paradise and Sentosa.

group_trips.title: Kuala Lumpur, Genting and Penang Group Trip
group_trips.summary: An escorted six-day Malaysia trip taking in Kuala Lumpur, Batu Caves, Genting Highlands and the heritage streets of George Town in Penang.
group_trips.overview:
This escorted trip shows you the best of peninsular Malaysia in six days. You start in Kuala Lumpur with the Petronas Twin Towers, Merdeka Square and Batu Caves, then ride a cable car up to the cool hills of Genting Highlands.

From there the group travels by road to Penang, an island known for its colonial buildings, street art, temples and food. A trip captain stays with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Kuala Lumpur city tour with a photo stop at the Petronas Twin Towers
Merdeka Square and the National Monument
Batu Caves and its colourful limestone temple stairway
Cable car ride to Genting Highlands
Scenic drive from Kuala Lumpur to Penang
George Town heritage walk and street art
Kek Lok Si Temple and Penang Hill by funicular railway
Trip captain with the group throughout

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur | Evening at leisure
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, where you are met and transferred to the hotel.
Check in and meet your trip captain for a short briefing on the days ahead.
The evening is free to rest or walk around the city.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour | Batu Caves
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out on a guided tour of Kuala Lumpur with a photo stop at the Petronas Twin Towers.
See Merdeka Square and the National Monument.
Continue to Batu Caves to climb the steps to the temple cave.
Return to the hotel with free time in the evening.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands by Cable Car
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to the base of the cable car and ride up to Genting Highlands.
Enjoy the cool mountain air and views over the forested hills.
Spend the day exploring the resort area at your own pace.
Ride the cable car back down and return to Kuala Lumpur.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Drive to Penang | Gurney Drive Evening
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and travel by coach to Penang, a drive of around four to five hours with rest stops.
Check in to the hotel on arrival and rest.
In the evening, walk along the Gurney Drive seafront, known for its local food stalls.
Overnight stay in Penang.

itinerary.title: George Town Heritage | Kek Lok Si Temple | Penang Hill
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore George Town on a guided walk past colonial buildings, clan houses and street art.
Visit Kek Lok Si Temple, one of the largest Buddhist temples in Malaysia.
Ride the funicular railway up Penang Hill for views over the island.
Some free time is kept for shopping and snacks.
Overnight stay in Penang.

itinerary.title: Departure from Penang
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel.
Transfer to Penang International Airport for your onward flight.
Depart with memories of Malaysia.

group_trips.title: Langkawi Island Hopping and Beaches Group Trip
group_trips.summary: An escorted five-day island break in Langkawi with beach time, the Sky Bridge, island hopping to the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden and a mangrove tour.
group_trips.overview:
Langkawi is an island group off Malaysia's north-west coast, known for white-sand beaches, rainforest-covered hills and limestone islets. This relaxed five-day trip balances beach time with a mix of excursions, including the Sky Bridge on Mount Mat Cincang, an island hopping trip and a mangrove tour.

The pace is easy, with free time every day. A trip captain accompanies the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Free time at Pantai Cenang beach
SkyCab cable car and Langkawi Sky Bridge on Mount Mat Cincang
Eagle Square and Langkawi island tour
Island hopping to Pulau Dayang Bunting and the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden
Beras Basah Island beach stop
Mangrove tour with Gua Kelawar (Bat Cave) and limestone formations
Trip captain with the group throughout

itinerary.title: Arrival in Langkawi | Pantai Cenang Beach
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Langkawi International Airport, where you are met and transferred to the hotel.
Check in and meet your trip captain for a short briefing.
The afternoon is free to relax or walk along Pantai Cenang beach.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Langkawi Island Tour | SkyCab and Sky Bridge
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out on a tour of the island with a photo stop at Eagle Square.
Ride the SkyCab cable car up Mount Mat Cincang.
Walk out onto the Langkawi Sky Bridge for views over the rainforest and the sea.
Return to the hotel with the evening free.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping | Lake of the Pregnant Maiden
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, board a boat for a half-day island hopping trip.
Visit Pulau Dayang Bunting and its freshwater Lake of the Pregnant Maiden.
Stop at Beras Basah Island for a beach break.
Return to the hotel for a free afternoon.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Mangrove Tour | Leisure Afternoon
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, take a boat tour through the mangroves, passing limestone formations.
Visit Gua Kelawar (Bat Cave) and see the fish farms in the open sea.
The rest of the day is free for the beach, shopping or spa treatments at your own cost.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Langkawi
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel.
Transfer to Langkawi International Airport for your onward flight.
Depart with memories of Langkawi.
